endpoints.name: $events
endpoints.notes: Open before session/prompt. The same owner Peer that opens it must answer $events/result. Reopen after every new e2e session.

endpoints.name: $events/result
endpoints.notes: args are exactly {clientId,eventId,outcome}; do not wrap in {args}. Same owner Peer as the $events stream; first answer wins, later answers are no-ops. Never auto-retry after a lost reply.

endpoints.name: session/follow
endpoints.notes: DSH 0.2.2-rc.1: assistantStream must be absent or literal true. Reopen after reconnect and extend the snapshot backwards with session/page until the last delivered seq is covered; dedupe by event seq.

endpoints.name: session/list
endpoints.notes: DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 requires the reserved _request member: send {"_request":{}}. The current App sends {} at the listed call sites; the D-stage iOS PR fixes them.

endpoints.name: session/prompt
